name: Appartement Seeberger
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Appartement Seeberger in Strengen is a holiday apartment in the Stanzer Valley. The accommodation is located at the edge of the village and offers views of the surrounding mountainous landscape. The apartment features a kitchenette, a living area, a bedroom, and a separate bathroom. Depending on the unit, there is either a balcony or a terrace available. Guests have access to a ski storage and a parking space. The location is ideal for hiking in the summer and serves as a starting point for trips to the ski resort St. Anton am Arlberg. The nearest ski shuttle is within walking distance. The accommodation is offered without any included meals.
